support_spans: a transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells arranged in nested and fascicular patterns, with variable eosinophilic or clear cytoplasm, round to oval vesicular nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli, and up to 10 mitoses per 10 high-power fields
diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10
a 30 mm by 25 mm polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass arising from the small-intestinal wall
mucosal ulceration but no melanin pigment, lymphovascular invasion, or perineural invasion, and three mesenteric lymph nodes were negative for tumor
contradict_spans: HMB45 and Melan A were negative
CD117, DOG1, cytokeratin, CD34, smooth muscle actin, desmin, chromogranin, and CD56 were all negative
